scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/sdk.ts --outdir dist --target bun && bun build src/cli.ts --outdir dist/cli --target bun && bun build src/mcp.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun && bun build src/serve.ts --outdir dist/serve --target bun && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run contract:check
scripts.scan:artifact: bun pm pack --ignore-scripts --quiet --filename "$PWD/__MEMBER__-artifact-scan.tgz" && bunx @hasna/contracts@0.11.1 artifact-scan __MEMBER__-artifact-scan.tgz; rc=$?; rm -f "$PWD/__MEMBER__-artifact-scan.tgz"; exit $rc
scripts.prepack: bun run verify && bun run scan:artifact
